title: La Pared
rule: Fourteen clusters of five hands. Within each cluster the hands shrink one generation at a time and exactly one hand is inverted; the clusters are separated by empty rock.

readings.far: a wall of ochre and charcoal handprints: a census, a crowd, a population
readings.middle: clusters of five generations each, some sprayed, some stamped, a few so old they are nearly gone
readings.near: a quadcopter painted in the same ochre in the clearing; tallies in three corners; one inverted hand per cluster

statement: A wall of hands is the oldest census we have. I painted it as a count: fourteen clusters, five generations each, one hand in every cluster turned upside down - the one that did not survive the count. The only modern object on the wall is a drone, painted in the same ochre, in the one clearing.
